【Fee】Adults ¥4,000 | Elementary school children ¥3,000 | Preschool children ¥1,500 (includes guide, insurance, lunch)

【Capacity】2 groups (up to 4 people per group)

【Guide】Tairakurien staff

【What to bring】Drinks, apron, headscarf, towel, mask
